name: Ankle Dislocation
definition: Displacement of the talus from the ankle mortise, usually associated with fracture and soft-tissue injury.

investigations.principle: Radiographs confirm injury; urgent reduction should not be delayed when skin or neurovascular status is threatened.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Post-reduction CT is often needed for associated fractures.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha-Sandhi displacement phenotype may be documented after emergency reduction.

patientEducation.summary: Displacement of the talus from the ankle mortise, usually associated with fracture and soft-tissue injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
